title: Hashicorp Security Advisories - 2026-09-10
description:
Merged 5 hashicorp security advisories published on 2026-09-10. Original advisory IDs: HCSEC-2026-38, HCSEC-2026-37, HCSEC-2026-36, HCSEC-2026-35, HCSEC-2026-34

Titles:
- HCSEC-2026-38 - Consul-template vulnerable to an information disclosure issue in error handling
- HCSEC-2026-37 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in the Connect service mesh
- HCSEC-2026-36 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in the catalog deregistration path
- HCSEC-2026-35 - Consul vulnerable to a denial of service in the native RPC listener
- HCSEC-2026-34 - Consul vulnerable to an authorization bypass in the catalog node-write path
